description_en: Correlates registry modifications to EventLog or WMI Autologger keys, suspicious use of Set-EtwTraceProvider, and Sysmon configuration changes. Defender sees interruption or redirection of ETW and log event collection.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: Detects disabling or reconfiguration of syslog or rsyslog services. Monitors sudden stops in logging daemons and suspicious execution of kill or service stop commands targeting syslog processes.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: Detection of tampering with Apple's Unified Logging framework or modification of system log forwarding settings. Defender observes execution of logd-related commands or defaults write to logging preferences.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: Detection of syslog configuration tampering using esxcli system syslog config set or reload. Defender correlates command execution with absence of syslog forwarding activity.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: Unusual service stop events, termination of AV/EDR processes, registry modifications disabling security tools, and firewall/defender configuration changes. Correlate process creation with service stop requests and registry edits.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: Execution of commands that stop or kill processes associated with logging or security daemons (auditd, syslog, falco). Detect modifications to iptables or disabling SELinux/AppArmor enforcement. Correlate sudo/root context with abrupt service halts.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: Execution of commands or APIs that disable Gatekeeper, XProtect, or system integrity protections. Detect configuration changes through unified logs. Monitor termination of system security daemons (e.g., syspolicyd).
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: Modification of container runtime security profiles (AppArmor, seccomp) or removal of monitoring agents within containers. Detect unauthorized mounting/unmounting of host /proc or /sys to disable logging or auditing.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: Unusual ESXi shell commands disabling syslog forwarding or stopping hostd/vpxa daemons. Detect modifications to firewall rules on ESXi host or disabling of lockdown mode.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: Cloud control plane actions disabling security services (CloudTrail logging, GuardDuty, Security Hub). Detect IAM role abuse correlating with service disable events.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: Changes to security configurations such as disabling MFA requirements, reducing session token lifetimes, or turning off risk-based policies. Correlate admin logins with sudden policy downgrades.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: Execution of commands disabling AAA, logging, or security features on routers/switches. Detect privilege escalation followed by config changes that disable defense mechanisms.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: Disabling of security macros or safe mode settings within Word/Excel/Outlook. Detect registry edits or configuration file changes that weaken macro enforcement.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: An analyst observes an authenticated AI interaction initiate resource access, tool invocation, API operation, or privileged activity outside $AuthorizedAIWorkflow$ or $AICapabilityScope$, without an authorized workflow transition permitting the operation.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index

description_en: An analyst observes a supported security artifact/task enter an autonomous defensive-analysis workflow, the analysis begin successfully, and the same workflow subsequently record an explicit failure, refusal, termination, or abnormal terminal state inconsistent with $AuthorizedAnalysisStopConditions$.
source: MITRE ATT&CK v20 HTML analytics index
